The **Software Maintenance and Intelligent Evolution** (SMILE) Research Group at the [University of Michigan-Flint](https://umflint.edu/) focuses on designing and implementing intelligent algorithms to tackle software engineering problems. Our goal is to help developers better maintain and evolve software systems.

We welcome motivated students at all levels (bachelor’s, master’s, and PhD) who are interested in joining the group. To inquire, contact Mohamed Wiem Mkaouer at [mmkaouer@umich.edu](mailto:mmkaouer@umich.edu).
